english: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.

chinese: 好的，今天我们要化浓妆。实际上我们在店里买化妆品。

chinese: 我对化妆种类原来还有这么多都不知道。今天我们来学习这些。

chinese: 饿了，去吃点东西吧。嗯，我也一样。哦，能快速停一下买个东西吗？

english: I lost my makeup bag at the airport and I want to pick up a few things.
chinese: 我在机场丢了化妆品袋，想买点东西。

english: Will you take long? No, five minutes. I promise.
chinese: 你再拍长吗？不，五分钟。我保证。

english: Come on. We've been here for almost an hour. I thought you said you're only going to get a few things.
chinese: 快点。我们已经等了将近一个小时。我以为你只是要带一些东西出来。

english: How long does it take you to pick out a lipstick and some nail polish? Are you crazy?
chinese: 你挑选口红和指甲油需要多长时间？你疯了吗？

english: You have no idea what you're talking about. Just for my eyes, I have to get eyeliner and eyelash curler, eyeshadow, and eyebrow pencil and mascara.
chinese: 你完全不懂。为了让我好看一点，我得买眼线、睫毛夹、腮红和眉笔以及睫毛膏。

english: Then I need to get foundation, liquid foundation.
chinese: 然后我需要粉底液。

english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Are you nuts? How much is all this going to cost?
chinese: 啊哈，别闹了。这要花多少钱啊？

english: I'm looking at the price of each one of these little things and it's outrageous. This is basically a crann.
chinese: 这些小东西的价格我都看不过来了，简直就是一个破罐子。

english: What about you? You spend as much money or more on your razors after shave, cologne, and tell.
chinese: 你呢？你在剃须刀、护手霜和香水上花费的钱与日俱增。

english: Not to mention how much you spend on clothes and... Fine, get the stupid $30 crann.
chinese: 何况你还要花那么多钱在衣服上……好吧，拿那愚蠢的$30去吧。

english: Alright, we're back. So obviously we're getting a lot of things for this girl, a lot of makeup.
chinese: 好的，我们又回来了。所以很明显，我们要给她准备很多东西，很多化妆品。

english: So I think there are a couple of things that we may not know about. So let's take a look at them now on the language takeaway.
chinese: 所以我想可能还有一些我们不了解的事情。那么我们现在就来看一下语言 takeaway 上的这些。

english: Language takeaway.
chinese: 语言 takeaway。

english: So the first thing we're talking about today is a basic. Most women carry this around in their purses. It's called lipstick.
chinese: 所以今天我们讨论的第一个是基础款。大多数女性都会随身携带这个。它叫口红。

english: That's right. And as you said, this is a pretty basic thing. It's the kind of like paint that you put on your lips.
chinese: 没错。正如你说的，这是一件相当基础的事情，就像是你涂在嘴唇上的那种颜料。

english: And it's called a lipstick because it looks like a little stick.
chinese: 这就是所谓的口红妆，因为它看起来像一根小棍。

english: Right, and you turn it with your fingers and it comes up and then you turn it again and it goes down, basically keeping it from touching all the things in your purse.
chinese: 对了，你用手转动它，就会上升，然后再转一次就会下降，基本上保持不触碰到钱包里的所有东西。

english: That's right. So lipstick. And well apart from this, we also have nail polish. And this is also very popular with the ladies when you paint your nails a certain color.
chinese: 没错。还有口红。而且除此之外，我们还有指甲油。你把指甲涂成某种颜色时，这也非常受女士们的欢迎。

english: That's right. So polish is basically anything that makes something shiny. It's something that you add to surfaces.
chinese: 没错。抛光其实就是让东西变得闪亮的一切，是添加到表面的东西。

english: So you could add polish to wood on a table. But in this case, we're putting it on our nails. That is fingernails or toenails. So it's nail polish.
chinese: 所以你可以给桌面上的木头上光。但在这种情况下，我们是在给我们的指甲上光。那是手指甲或脚趾甲。这就是指甲油。

english: All right, very good. And now we're getting into the specific things a lot of makeup that women use on their eyes.
chinese: 好的，非常好。现在我们要进入很多女性用于眼妆的具体细节。

english: So for example, the first thing she said, she needs to get an eyeliner.
chinese: 所以比如说，她第一句话就说，她需要买个眼线笔。

english: Okay, so eyeliner is basically a pencil. This is what the guy is making fun of her about. He says it's just a pencil or crayon for your eye.
chinese: 好的，眼线其实就是一支铅笔。这就是他讽刺她的地方。他说那是你眼睛用的铅笔或者蜡笔。

english: And so basically you use it to draw a line on the top or the bottom of your eye, your eyelid.
chinese: 然后基本上你用它在眼睛的上部或下部画一条线。

english: Okay, so yeah, it kind of looks like a marker and it comes, I think, black and different colors. And then you paint little lines around your eyes to make them more pronounced.
chinese: 好的，看起来有点像记号笔，它有黑色和其他颜色。然后你还会在眼睛周围画上小线条使其更加明显。

english: So it's called an eyeliner.
chinese: 这就是眼线。

english: Okay, and now we have an eyelash curler. And also I think this is very important for the ladies.
chinese: 好的，现在我们有了一个睫毛夹。而且我觉得这对女士们非常重要。

english: Yeah, well, not everyone uses this. It's a little bit of a scary instrument. It looks like it might pop your eye out.
chinese: 是的，不过并不是所有人都用这个。这是一样让人有些害怕的工具。看起来它可能会把你的眼球弹出来。

english: It's something you use on your eyelashes. So those are the hairs that come off of your eye. And basically you use this to make them curly or to make them seem a bit longer and prettier.
chinese: 这是你用来睫毛上的东西。所以那些是脱落的眼睫毛。基本上你可以用它来让它们变得卷曲，或者让它看起来稍微长一些更漂亮。

english: So an eyelash curler is something that it's like almost like a press or something for your eyelashes.
chinese: 所以睫毛夹就像是一个类似的眼线器或者什么东西。

english: Okay, very good. And well, now that we've got that covered, we move on to eyeshadow. And I think this goes on your eyelid, right?
chinese: 好的，很好。那么现在我们来谈一下眼影吧，我想这是涂在眼皮上的吗？

english: That's right. Some people make it go further. They put it on their face above their eyelid, but that's a little bit crazy.
chinese: 没错，有些人做到了。他们把它放在眼睑上方的脸部，但这也太疯狂了。

english: I think eyeshadow generally goes like you said on your eyelid and it can be in many different colors. So blue, pink, red, whatever.
chinese: 我认为眼影一般是你所说的涂在眼皮上，可以有很多种颜色，比如蓝色、粉色、红色等等。

english: People sometimes go crazy with eyeshadow.
chinese: 人们有时会疯狂地使用眼影。

english: Okay. And now what about an eyebrow pencil?
chinese: 好的。那眉笔呢？

english: This is basically a pencil for filling in or for coloring your eyebrows. Sometimes people like to make their eyebrows look darker or thicker.
chinese: 这基本上是一款用来填充眉毛或给眉毛上色的眉笔。有时候人们喜欢让自己的眉毛看起来更深或者更粗。

english: And so they use this pencil. It's usually brown or black and they use it on their eyebrows.
chinese: 而他们就用这支铅笔。通常它是棕色或黑色的，用于眉毛上。

english: So we picked up a lot of a vocab. You're related to your eye, for example, an eyelash, your eyelid. Now we're talking about the eyebrows which are the hairs on top, more or less around your forehead.
chinese: 所以我们学到了很多词汇，比如与眼睛相关的睫毛、眼皮。现在我们谈到的是眉毛，它们是头顶上的一些毛发，大致位于前额附近。

english: And now we also have another type of makeup called mascara.
chinese: 现在我们还有另一种叫做睫毛膏的化妆类型。

english: Another basic, so like we said earlier, lipstick is something you almost always find in a woman's purse. Well mascara is another one of those things. Almost everybody wears mascara.
chinese: 另一个基本款，正如我们之前所说，口红几乎总是出现在女人们的包里。至于睫毛膏，这也是一种几乎人人都会用到的东西。

english: This is kind of like a brush for your eyelashes and it paints them a different color.
chinese: 这就像你睫毛的刷子，它可以给它们涂上不同的颜色。

english: So most women wear black or brown and it makes your eyelashes look really long.
chinese: 所以大多数女性穿黑色或棕色，会让你的睫毛看起来特别长。

english: Okay. Very good. So this is kind of like paint for your eyelashes.
chinese: 好的。很好。这就像你的眼线画笔。

english: And now moving away from your eyelashes, we're going to have, we're buying also some foundation and liquid foundation.
chinese: 然后远离你的睫毛，我们还要买一些粉底和液体粉底。

english: Okay. So foundation is just a kind of base for your face. So foundation like a building is the very bottom.
chinese: 好的。所以底妆其实就是你脸部的基础，所以底妆就像一座建筑的最底层。

english: Well in this case it's something that you put on your cheeks, on your face in general, on your forehead.
chinese: 在这个情况下，那是你脸颊、脸庞乃至额头上的东西。

english: You're kind of smooth your skin out and make it look all the same color or the same texture.
chinese: 你把皮肤抹平，让它看起来是同一种颜色或同一种质地。

english: And so foundation can be like, like we see here either a powder which is kind of like a dry substance or you can use liquid foundation, which is like it says liquid.
chinese: 而且底妆可以像这里看到的那样，要么是类似干物质的粉状物，你可以使用液体底妆，就像它所说的那样是一种液体。

english: It's almost like a thick cream.
chinese: 这几乎就像一种爽肤水。

english: Alright so foundation is as you said, I guess you just want to make your skin look the same color, the same texture.
chinese: 好的，基础就是你所说的，我想你是想让皮肤看起来一样的颜色、一样的质感。

english: Because obviously not everyone's skin is perfect. We all have some spots maybe or some different color on our face.
chinese: 因为毕竟每个人的皮肤都不是完美的。我们脸上都有些斑点，或者有些不同颜色的地方。

english: You say we like you wear foundation too. Do you wear makeup marker?
chinese: 你说我们喜欢你用粉底。你用遮瑕膏吗？

english: Well I mean we as people because you know, alright no no no no none of this makeup for me. Although I have used an eyelash curler once.
chinese: 嗯，其实是我们这些普通人。你知道的，好吧，这和我一点关系都没有。虽然我用卷睫毛夹过一次。

english: That's scary.
chinese: 那真是可怕。

english: Well my friends dared me to so okay.
chinese: 朋友们让我敢这么干，好吧。

english: I love that.
chinese: 我喜欢这一点。

english: Of course. Now I use it all the time. No no. But what I do use is now things related to guys.
chinese: 当然了。现在我全用上了。不不，但我现在用的是和男性相关的东西。

english: So for example the girlfriend was saying well you buy razors and aftershave. So what are these things?
chinese: 所以比如说女朋友说，你买刀片和护手霜吧。这些是什么？

english: Well razors aren't just a guy thing. Everyone can have a razor. It's basically a blade like a very sharp piece of metal that you use to cut hair.
chinese: 刀片不只是男性的东西。每个人都可以用刀片。它基本上是一把像非常锋利的金属片一样的刀，用来剪头发。

english: So the hair on your legs, the hair on your face. These are things that you cut with a razor.
chinese: 你的腿毛，脸上的毛发，这些都是用剃须刀剪掉的。

english: And menus razors to shave their faces, shave their chins or above their lip.
chinese: 并且菜单上提供剃须刀来刮脸、刮下巴或唇部上方。

english: Alright and well actually after we shave our beard we put on a little bit of aftershave which is basically kind of like alcohol that smells really nice.
chinese: 好的实际上，剃须后我们还会抹一点 aftershave，这是一种类似于闻起来很香的酒精。

english: That's right because shaving can actually hurt your skin or the hairs under your skin can become really itchy or irritated.
chinese: 那就是因为剃须实际上会伤害你的皮肤，或者你皮肤下的毛发可能会变得非常痒或刺痛。

english: And so aftershave helps make everything feel better.
chinese: 而 aftershave 能让一切都感觉更好。

english: Okay and well in sometimes we also use a little bit of cologne to smell nice.
chinese: 好吧，有时候我们也会用一点香水闻着香。

english: So women usually wear perfume which is you know all the perfumes like CK and Hugo Boss and all that stuff.
chinese: 所以女性通常会用香水，比如大家都知道的CK和Hugo Boss等所有这些东西。

english: As well as for guys it's usually called cologne.
chinese: 作为男性通常也叫古龙水。

english: Okay that's right it's an important difference there because we don't say perfume for guys and we don't say cologne for girls.
chinese: 好的，这就是一个重要的区别，因为我们不说男士用香水，也不说女士香水。

english: So women wear perfume like you said but men wear cologne and this word is very funny looking.
chinese: 所以你说到女性会用香水，男性则用古龙水，这个词语看起来非常有趣。

english: It ends with it's spelled C-O-L-O-G-N-E.
chinese: 它以 Cologn e 这种拼写结束。

english: So you don't really say the G it's not collogna.
chinese: 所以你其实不说G，这不是Colonna。

english: Right. It's cologne and it's something that you put on your knack or your face to smell really good if you're a man.
chinese: 明白了，是香水，男士用来喷在手腕或脸上的，能闻起来很香。

english: Exactly.
chinese: Exactly.

english: And finally if you have long hair or maybe you have very spiky hair like I do you need to wear a little bit of gel to kind of give your head a little bit of shape.
chinese: 最后，如果你有长发或者像我一样有着非常凌乱的头发，你需要稍微用一些发胶来给你的头型做一个小小的修饰。

english: That's right so gel is actually the name of a kind of substance it's not liquid but it's not hard either.
chinese: 没错，胶水其实是一种物质的名称，它不是液体，也不是固体。

chinese: 而且它基本上是像你用来固定头发在一处的胶状物一样。

chinese: 是的，可以让你的头发稍微硬一些，或者让你的发型保持更长的时间。

chinese: 好的，这里有很多词汇，我们学过很多东西。不如今天我们的话题来个回顾，好好复习一下今天的这些新词新句吧。

chinese: 你会长时间吗？

chinese: 你挑选口红和指甲油需要多长时间？

chinese: 为了让我眼睛好看，我需要眼线、睫毛夹、眼影、眉笔和睫毛膏。

chinese: 然后我需要粉底液。

chinese: 啊哈哈你神经病啊

chinese: 这所有的东西要多少钱？

chinese: 这些小东西的价格真是昂贵。

chinese: 这基本上是脑残粉。

chinese: 你花在剃须刀、护手霜、香水和凝胶上的钱一样多，或者更多。

english: Alright we're back so now we're going to take a look at three short phrases that we've picked out for you on Fluency Builder.
chinese: 好的，我们回来了，那么现在我们要来看看流利构建单元上挑选出来的三个短语。

chinese: 流利构建单元。

english: So this first phrase is something that we almost always say with our friends or family.
chinese: 所以这个第一句话我们几乎总是和朋友或家人说。

english: When we're hungry, we're shopping.
chinese: 当我们饿的时候，我们就会去购物。

english: You know, but sometimes you're outside and you just really want to eat.
chinese: 你知道，但有时候你在外边真的好想吃。

english: You say, hey let's grab a bite to eat.
chinese: 你说来吃点东西吧。

english: That's right.
chinese: 没错。

english: So this is a very natural colloquial way of saying let's go get something to eat.
chinese: 所以这很自然的一句就是让我们去吃点东西吧。

english: Let's go eat something.
chinese: 我们去吃点东西吧。

english: So it could be small, it could be a snack like an ice cream, but it can also be dinner.
chinese: 那么它可以很小，就像一个冰激凌一样，也可以是一顿晚餐。

english: So hey, do you want to go grab a bite to eat sometime?
chinese: 那么嘿，你 sometime 想去吃点东西吗？

chinese: 那意思是，嘿，你什么时候想去吃午饭或者晚饭呢？

english: Very good. So the phrase is, grab a bite or go grab a bite to eat.
chinese: 非常好。所以这句话是，grab a bite 或者 go grab a bite to eat。

english: So a bite can be a noun like a thing, like a piece of food that you eat, but it can also be a verb to bite.
chinese: 所以一口既可以作为名词，像一个东西，比如你吃的一块食物，也可以作为动词咬。

english: Like, you know, the dog bites the man.
chinese: 你知道的，狗咬人。

english: And so you have to be careful with this one. In this case it's a noun.
chinese: 而且你得小心这个。这是一个名词。

english: Okay, very good.
chinese: 好的，非常好。

english: And well, she wanted to first go to the store and she said, I want to pick up a few things.
chinese: 而且，她想先去商店，她说，我想买些东西。

english: Well, usually when you pick something up, you take it from a table or from the ground.
chinese: 嗯，通常当你拿起什么东西时，你是从桌子上或者地上拿起来的。

english: You have to pay for it.
chinese: 你需要付钱。

chinese: 好的。比如说，你回家的时候能顺便买一盒牛奶吗？

chinese: 那么你可以在回家的路上买些牛奶吗？

chinese: 这不代表你可以从别人那里拿取或者偷窃。

english: Exactly. All right.
chinese: 明白了。好。

english: So to pick something up, to buy, to go and get, but obviously you have to pay.
chinese: 所以拿起东西来买，去拿，当然你必须付钱。

english: All right. And he used this very interesting phrase when she was getting all these things for her.

chinese: 说的就是这个，也就是疯狂的意思。

english: So if you call someone nuts or you say he's nuts, that means.

chinese: 是啊，别跟他说话，他脑子有病。

chinese: 他总是说 really 危险的话。他 nuts 了。

english: So he's a little bit crazy.
chinese: 他有点儿疯狂。

english: So it's an adjective as to describe someone that's a little bit crazy or a little bit adventurous maybe.
chinese: 这就是用来描述一个人有点疯狂或有点冒险的形容词。

english: Are you crazy or he's basically saying, do you really want to do this?

english: This seems like a bad decision.
chinese: 这似乎是个糟糕的决定。

english: Exactly. So that's why he used the phrase, are you nuts?
chinese: 正是如此，他才用了那句话，你疯了吗？
